archetypes.name: dyn-public-routing
archetypes.rationale: Security-routing prompt text should keep uncertain findings off public issue paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed implementer prompt wording for security-routing correctness. Confirm that certain and uncertain security findings cannot be folded inline or filed through public OOS paths, and that the generated Codex and Cursor prompts stayed in sync with the shared base. Check whether the compact wording remains clear enough for external implementers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
